newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: BAe, SAfrica's ATE seal defence partnership.
newsitem.headline: BAe, SAfrica's ATE seal defence partnership.

text.p: Europe's largest defence firm British Aerospace Plc has taken a minority stake in South Africa's private Advanced Technologies & Engineering Co (ATE) in order to forge a strategic partnership, the companies said on Thursday.
The move creates the biggest defence industry alliance between European and South African firms.
ATE specialises in integrated avionics systems and also develops Unmanned Airborne Vehicles (UAVs). BAe's stake of around 20 percent was bought for an undisclosed sum.
"The minority interest is around 20 percent, but it has not been finalised yet," said ATE managing director and founder Jean-Marc Pizano.
Pizano said the exact level of the stake was still unclear, because the group was soon hoping to bring on board black interest groups as shareholders.
"We hope to make significant and affirmative announcements in this regard in the new year." he added.

Allan MacDonald, BAe managing director for southern Africa, said it was eventually hoped to integrate the whole of ATE into BAe. But he said the process could take about five years and it was up to BAe to prove to ATE management that this was the best policy.

"We would very much like to increase our stake in ATE, but it is vital for the success of ATE that present management contines to run the company...we have to prove to them that the best success can be achieved with a full integration," he said.

The world defence industry is consolidating and BAe has struck numerous partnerships throughout the world. MacDonald said such an alliance-based strategy was now the only way to conduct business in the sector.

The deal will see ATE gain access to international markets and BAe will provide marketing support for ATE products, including its UAVs like the Vulture model which has just been selected by the South African army.
Pizano said mutual benefits of the alliance would see technology and skill exchanges and personnel development.
